questions.question: What disposition should ID-150 record for verify-tla?

options.label: Re-defer, bridge-bound (Recommended)
options.description: Keep informational. Record that it cannot catch code regressions (no bridge). Successor ticket revisits on the earlier of 2027-04-19 or the first bridged TLA module (BK-454/455), which must gate in its own PR. Answers RFC-0022 OQ3: gating follows the bridge, per module.

options.label: Promote now
options.description: Add verify-tla to gate.needs (9 s, only on TLA/ci.yml diffs). Closes BK-333's TLA bullet. Gates model self-consistency only; per D5 Observer still governs nothing without a bridge. Needs rule 3's 'real catch' bar waived.

options.label: Remove
options.description: Drop the job; Observer.tla becomes unrun. Contradicts RFC-0022 D4/D5, which plan TLA+ as the lifetime source; the job would be re-added for BK-454/455.

options.label: Plain re-defer
options.description: Same status, successor due 2027-04-19, no rule change. Leaves the rule-3 vs D5 deadlock for the RFC's ADR.

questions.question: Where should the changed promotion rule (README § Authoring rules 3) land?

options.label: RFC-0022 OQ3 only (Recommended)
options.description: This PR answers OQ3 in the RFC and records the decision in ID-150's close; README rule 3 is rewritten when RFC-0022 graduates to its ADR (avoids pre-empting a Draft RFC). README gets only a pointer to the successor ticket.

options.label: README now
options.description: Amend rule 3 in this PR: an unbridged module stays informational; a bridged module gates from its first PR; cadence counts amendments to TLA-backed sections. Ships the rule before the ADR.

questions.question: Should this PR also fix the README's cadence wording that the index entry flags (10 amendments, 'production branch')?

options.label: Narrow to TLA-backed (Recommended)
options.description: Count amendments to sections a TLA module models (spec 019 today: 4 since April), drop 'on a production branch'. Matches what ID-150's index already says it narrows.

options.label: Leave as is
options.description: Keep the literal 10-spec-amendment cadence (already overdue ~14x) and the production-branch bar; note the mismatch only.
